reply_text:

I've sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request. I didn't include the rate in that message. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft to Marcus (mlindqvist@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate" and the $1,752-a-seat figure, ready for you to send. If you'd rather have Anselm look at it, or you can nudge June yourself, that might speed things up.
